display.purpose: Primary propositions and no other interface role.

headline.purpose: Editable and translated content inside the paper panels.

label.purpose: Actions, counts, status, and categorical metadata.

shadows.name: paper-lift
shadows.purpose: Shared ambient shadow for the primary paper surfaces.

shadows.name: bridge-lift
shadows.purpose: Structural lift for the circular direction control crossing the panel rail.

shadows.name: status-halo
shadows.purpose: Compact semantic halo around a trust or success dot.

motion.name: transfer
motion.purpose: Moves the blue signal across the direction rail and flips its glyph.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Collapses animation to effectively instantaneous feedback when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The single solid-blue submit action used within a working panel.
components.css: .ds-primary-action { min-height: 46px; padding: 0 17px 0 20px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius, 14px); color: white; background: var(--blue, #0a66c2); font: 700 0.78rem "DM Sans", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary-action:hover { background: var(--blue-dark, #004182); } .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #70b5f9; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-primary-action:active { background: var(--blue-dark, #004182); } .ds-primary-action:disabled { color: var(--line, #d8dadd); background: #7f858a; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-primary-action svg { width: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Example Chip
components.description: A secondary prompt shortcut that stays outlined until interaction.
components.css: .ds-example-chip { padding: 7px 11px; border: 1px solid #c8cbd0; border-radius: 999px; color: #4a5055; background: transparent; font: 600 0.76rem "DM Sans", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-example-chip:hover { color: var(--blue-dark, #004182); border-color: var(--blue, #0a66c2); background: var(--blue-soft, #e8f3ff); } .ds-example-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #70b5f9; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-example-chip:active { color: var(--blue-dark, #004182); background: var(--blue-soft, #e8f3ff); }

components.name: Paper Panel
components.description: The lifted warm-paper container for source and destination work.
components.html:
Panel title
Working content belongs here.
components.css: .ds-paper-panel { min-height: 300px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; color: var(--ink, #101214); background: var(--paper, #f8f7f4); border-radius: var(--radius, 14px); box-shadow: 0 22px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28); font-family: "DM Sans", sans-serif; } .ds-paper-panel__heading { min-height: 62px; padding: 0 24px; display: flex; align-items: center; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #d8dadd); font-weight: 700; } .ds-paper-panel__content { flex: 1; padding: 24px; font-size: 1.2rem; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Editor Field
components.description: A borderless, large-type writing field that relies on its paper container for shape.
components.css: .ds-editor-field { width: 100%; min-height: 230px; resize: none; padding: 24px; border: 0; outline: 0; color: var(--ink, #101214); background: var(--paper, #f8f7f4); font: 400 clamp(1.2rem, 2.2vw, 1.55rem)/1.5 "DM Sans", sans-serif; caret-color: var(--blue, #0a66c2); } .ds-editor-field::placeholder { color: #60676d; opacity: 1; } .ds-editor-field:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #70b5f9; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Direction Swap
components.description: The circular bridge control that sits between paired paper panels.
components.html: <button class="ds-direction-swap" type="button" aria-label="Switch direction"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7 7h11l-3-3m3 3-3 3M17 17H6l3 3m-3-3 3-3" /></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-direction-swap { width: 54px; height: 54px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 6px solid var(--stage, #07090a); border-radius: 50%; color: var(--blue, #0a66c2); background: white; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25); cursor: pointer; } .ds-direction-swap:hover { color: white; background: var(--blue, #0a66c2); } .ds-direction-swap:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #70b5f9; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-direction-swap:active svg { transform: rotate(180deg); } .ds-direction-swap svg { width: 22px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; transition: transform 700ms cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1); }

components.name: Copy Action
components.description: A compact transparent utility action for completed output.
components.css: .ds-copy-action { padding: 7px 10px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--blue-dark, #004182); background: transparent; font: 700 0.78rem "DM Sans", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-copy-action:hover { background: var(--blue-soft, #e8f3ff); } .ds-copy-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #70b5f9; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-copy-action:active { color: var(--blue, #0a66c2); background: var(--blue-soft, #e8f3ff); } .ds-copy-action:disabled { color: #9fa4a8; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-copy-action svg { width: 17px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Follow-up Composer
components.description: A compact pill field for refining work after the first result.
components.html: <form class="ds-followup"><input aria-label="Refine result" placeholder="Add a refinement…" /><button type="submit" aria-label="Send"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m5 12 14-7-4 14-3-6-7-1Z" /></svg></button></form>
components.css: .ds-followup { padding: 5px 5px 5px 13px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid #b7bbc0; border-radius: 999px; background: white; font-family: "DM Sans", sans-serif; } .ds-followup:focus-within { outline: 3px solid #70b5f9; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-followup input { min-width: 0; flex: 1; padding: 7px 0; border: 0; outline: 0; color: var(--ink, #101214); background: transparent; font: 400 0.84rem "DM Sans", sans-serif; } .ds-followup input::placeholder { color: #60676d; opacity: 1; } .ds-followup button { width: 34px; height: 34px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; color: white; background: var(--blue, #0a66c2); cursor: pointer; } .ds-followup button:hover, .ds-followup button:active { background: var(--blue-dark, #004182); } .ds-followup button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #70b5f9; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-followup svg { width: 17px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Masthead Brand
components.description: The compact stage-level brand lockup used in the restrained utility masthead.
components.css: .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: white; font: 700 1.05rem "Manrope", sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-brand:hover { color: white; } .ds-brand:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #70b5f9; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-brand:active { color: var(--stage-muted, #a9afb5); } .ds-brand__mark { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 31px; height: 31px; border-radius: 4px; color: white; background: var(--blue, #0a66c2); font: 700 1rem Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.04em; }

narrative.overview:
Plainly feels like a focused editorial workstation set on a dark stage. Two warm paper surfaces hold the work, while restrained LinkedIn blue identifies action, direction, and provenance. The composition borrows the familiar rhythm of a two-panel translator without borrowing its anonymity: assertive editorial type and a live center rail give the utility a point of view.

The system is copy-first, direct, and lightly humorous, but never decorative at the expense of the task. Generous black framing creates focus; compact utility controls stay quiet until needed. The visual identity references LinkedIn through color only and must never imply affiliation.
keyCharacteristics: Black stage with paired paper work surfaces.
One restrained blue accent for action, direction, and provenance.
Editorial display typography over compact, legible utility type.
Familiar translator geometry sharpened by a central transfer signal.
Quiet states, direct labels, and dense controls around spacious writing areas.

rules.name: The Blue Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Blue must signal action, direction, selection, or provenance; it does not become a decorative field.

rules.name: The Paper on Stage Rule
rules.body: Long-form input and output belong on warm paper, while the surrounding frame remains nearly black.

rules.name: The Editorial Lead, Utility Body Rule
rules.body: Manrope opens the experience; DM Sans performs every task beneath it.

rules.name: The Quiet Metadata Rule
rules.body: Small type may become bold or uppercase, but must stay muted and compact so it never competes with user content.

rules.name: The Paired Before Stacked Rule
rules.body: Preserve the source-and-destination relationship side by side whenever the viewport can support it; stack in the same reading order on narrow screens.

rules.name: The Paper Floats, Controls Don't Rule
rules.body: Elevate the working surfaces and their bridge; keep ordinary buttons, chips, and fields flat.

rules.name: The Soft Utility Rule
rules.body: Large surfaces use gentle corners, compact actions use pills or circles, and no component introduces ornamental geometry unrelated to its function.

rules.name: The One Loud Action Rule
rules.body: Within a panel, only the primary submit action receives a solid blue fill; all supporting actions stay transparent or outlined.

dos: Do preserve the black-stage, warm-paper, restrained-blue hierarchy across empty, loading, error, and history states.
Do keep source and destination surfaces equal in visual weight and reading order.
Do use blue only when an element is actionable, directional, selected, or provenance-bearing.
Do preserve strong keyboard focus, readable placeholders, and the reduced-motion fallback.
Do let writing space remain visually generous while controls stay compact.
donts: Don't imply a LinkedIn affiliation through logos, endorsement language, or copied brand assets; the relationship is limited to a familiar blue-and-neutral color cue.
Don't introduce additional decorative accent colors, gradients on paper, or shadows on every control.
Don't turn the two panels into unequal dashboard cards or separate the direction control from their shared rail.
Don't add competing motion; the single transfer signal is the system's signature movement.
Don't let metadata, helper text, or example chips compete with the editable and translated content.
